title: A Mars Mission Could Cost Astronauts 30% Of Hip Bone
hook: A Mars mission could cost astronauts 30% of hip bone density.
closing: Long missions need bone protection because floating removes the loading that keeps skeletons strong.
question: Would this change your Mars plans?

segments.say: Astronaut bone density can fall 1.5% monthly. Space removes the everyday loading that keeps skeletons strong.
Astronaut hip density can drop 2.2% monthly. Weight-bearing bone pays the highest price in these data.
A Mars mission could cost 30% of hip bone density without protection. Countermeasures become part of survival.
